name: @pierre-mike/axioms
description: Harness, CLI and app template for agent-built TypeScript apps on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build:biome: bun run harness/biome.rules.ts && biome format --write biome.json
scripts.lock:template: cd template && rm -f bun.lock && bun install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.verify: biome ci . && tsc --noEmit && bun run test && bun cli/main.ts notes
